note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 5 June 1958. The returning officer's notice of result (Eleanor Hollinger, returning officer, dated 6 June 1958) lists all 23 district electoral divisions: polls in Galgorm and Portglenone, 18 sole candidates declared elected, and in Glenwherry, Lisnagarron and Newtowncrommelin the retiring members deemed to be re-elected. No party labels are printed. Sole candidate, entered in the notice as elected with no votes recorded. Returned unopposed.
